title: Blocks
description: A collection of ready-to-use UI blocks for building modern websites and applications.

blocks.title: Navbar
blocks.description: Ready-to-use navigation bar blocks with multiple variants for different layouts, links, and responsive app navigation.

variants.title: Default
variants.description: Standard responsive navigation bar suitable for most websites.

variants.title: Sticky
variants.description: Navigation bar that stays fixed at the top while scrolling.

variants.title: Float
variants.description: Floating navigation bar with spacing from the viewport edges.

variants.title: Inset
variants.description: Navigation bar displayed within an inset container.

variants.title: Bottom
variants.description: Bottom navigation bar optimized for mobile applications.

blocks.title: Authentication
blocks.description: Beautifully designed authentication layouts and form blocks tailored for seamless login, signup, and auth experiences.

variants.title: Simple
variants.description: Minimal authentication form with a clean layout.

variants.title: Card
variants.description: Authentication form displayed inside a centered card.

variants.title: Card Image
variants.description: Card authentication layout paired with an illustration or image.

variants.title: Split
variants.description: Split-screen authentication layout with separate content and form sections.

blocks.title: Dashboard
blocks.description: Comprehensive dashboard layouts with various components and data visualization options.

blocks.title: Sidebar
blocks.description: Versatile vertical navigation panels with support for collapsible menus, nested links, and responsive mobile behaviors.

variants.title: Default
variants.description: Standard vertical sidebar for application navigation.

variants.title: Float
variants.description: Floating sidebar with spacing from the viewport edges.

variants.title: Inset
variants.description: Sidebar integrated within an inset layout container.

blocks.title: Footer
blocks.description: Stylish footer blocks with multiple layouts, including simple, centered, and multi-column designs for various website needs.

variants.title: Default
variants.description: Standard footer layout with essential links and information.

variants.title: Centered
variants.description: Footer with centered branding and navigation.

variants.title: Columns
variants.description: Multi-column footer for organizing links and resources.
